{{Quote|Intruders confirmed on the Jedi Cruiser. Notify the Empire.|The scrapper alerts an associate|<ref name="Battle Scars" />}}
A [[humanoid]] [[Gender|male]] '''scrapper''' worked for the [[Scrapper Guild]] on the junk-strewn [[planet]] [[Bracca]] following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. When the former [[clone commando]]s unit known as the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] visited Bracca to use the medical facility of one of the planet's wrecked [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], the scrapper spotted the [[clone trooper]] [[Hunter]] while on patrol. Confirming the presence of intruders, the scrapper told his companion to alert the Empire.<ref name="Battle Scars" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The scrapper appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Battle Scars]],"<ref name="Battle Scars" /> the seventh episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[June 11]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Liam O'Brien]].<ref name="Battle Scars" />
